description: EMBL-EBI Ontology Lookup Service (OLS4) — page through every biomedical ontology loaded into OLS, such as GO, EFO, MONDO, ChEBI, HPO and UBERON. Returns each ontology's id, title, description, term count, version and status, with size/page controls. Answers which biomedical ontologies are searchable here and what the short id for one is.
